title: Photonic line-graph flat band, apartment compact states, H1 tight frame, local address law, and disorder boundary
purpose: Translate the exact 160-coupler H1 theorem into a line-graph flat-band construction. Prove the -2 flat band, show that the 1620 Levi apartments are compact localized states spanning it as a unit-norm tight frame, and state the exact robustness boundary under uniform versus local perturbations.
coordination: Build on BT545-BT550 and Passes 4013-4018 without relabeling old results. Distinguish the secondary 160-site line-graph Hamiltonian from the primary 80-mode incidence device and from link-current dynamics.
boundary: Reservation only. External photonic flat-band literature is context, not evidence of a fabricated W33 lattice. No device, disorder tolerance, local synthesis, measured localization, variable vacuum c, or laboratory performance is promoted.
